name: Poddle
subtitle: Faster podcasts, no chipmunks
keywords: podcast,podcasts,player,trim silence,even volume,queue,up next,stats,year in review,poodle,speed
promotionalText: A podcast player I made for myself, with speed-ups that still sound like people talking and stats on how much you actually listen.
description:
Poddle is a podcast player I made for myself. It has one Up Next queue, speed-ups that still sound like people, and stats on how much you actually listen (a lot, in my case).

SPEED WITHOUT THE CHIPMUNKS
Poddle's Speech-tuned speed-up is made for voices, so 2x still sounds like the person talking. Poodle Trim snips out the silences between words (poodles do love a trim), and Even Volume sorts out quiet hosts and loud ads.

SETTINGS FOR EACH SHOW
Every show can have its own speed, Poodle Trim, Even Volume, intro and outro skips, and where its new episodes go. Or leave them on your defaults and forget about it.

BRING YOUR HISTORY WITH YOU
Import your shows, what you've played, where you're up to, your starred episodes and your whole listening history, so your stats start with everything you've already heard.

STATS AND YEAR IN REVIEW
See how long you've listened, how much time speed and Poodle Trim saved you, your top shows and your streaks. At the end of the year there's a Year in Review you can share.

DOWNLOADS THAT LOOK AFTER YOUR DATA
Poddle only downloads on Wi-Fi unless you say otherwise. Out and about and want something now? Allow mobile downloads for an hour, three hours or until tomorrow, and it goes back to Wi-Fi only by itself. Streaming works anywhere.

SHARE LINKS
Share an episode or a show and your friend gets a page that plays it in their browser, from the bit you meant, or opens it in Poddle if they have it.

AND A POODLE
Poddle sounds like poodle, so there's a fluffy cartoon poodle in headphones who keeps you company round the app. If it's a bit much you can turn the animation off in Profile.

Sign in with Apple or Google to keep your library in sync. No ads and no tracking.

Got an idea or found a bug? Tap "Suggest a feature" in Profile, or email poddle@mikecann.app.

ageRating._note: Poddle ships no objectionable content of its own, but it plays whatever podcasts people pick from Apple's directory or any feed, including ones marked explicit, and it doesn't filter them. So the themes and language that podcasts commonly have are answered 'infrequent or mild' rather than 'none'. Mike: change these if you'd rather rate it differently. Unknown keys are skipped, and keys Apple adds later are left as they are.

review.notes:
Thanks for taking a look at Poddle.

Sign-up is open to anyone, so no demo account is needed: tap "Sign in with Apple" or "Sign in with Google" on the first screen and you get a new, empty account of your own.

To add shows, use the Discover tab to search Apple's podcast directory, or paste a feed URL there.

To try the Overcast import without an Overcast account: open https://poddle.mikecann.app/sample-overcast.opml in Safari and save it to Files, then in Poddle go to Profile > Import from Overcast > Choose the OPML file and pick it. It brings in a few public shows and some listening history.

To delete the account: Profile > Delete account. It asks twice, signs you out straight away, and removes the account's data from the server.

Poddle plays podcasts from public RSS feeds that the listener chooses. It has no ads and no tracking. Microphone and speech recognition are only used if you record a voice note in "Suggest a feature" (Profile).
